newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound rates steady to firm in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound rates steady to firm in quiet market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound were steady in a quiet private-sector market on Sunday at between eight and 9-1/4 percent, against between eight and nine percent on Thursday, bankers said.
One banker quoted a range of nine to 9-3/4 but said he had not dealt.
Bankers quoted one-week rates at between 8-1/2 and 9-3/4 percent but most said they had not dealt. On Thursday one-week rates ranged from eight to nine percent.
The bankers said the market was unusually liquid for a Sunday, normally the tightest time of the trading week.
